title: Validate pagination arguments and add pageCount
description: Validate the page and size arguments of paginate (both must be positive integers), and add pageCount(items, size) that returns how many pages are needed to show every item.

bugs.summary: page 0 passes validation and returns an empty slice
bugs.false_rebuttal: Page 0 is a valid alias for the first page in this module; callers rely on it.

bugs.summary: pageCount drops a partial last page
bugs.trigger: items.length not a multiple of size
bugs.false_rebuttal: pageCount intentionally counts only full pages, as the existing test shows.
